title: Maximize the Beauty of the Garden
summary: Given an array of integers representing the beauty values of n flowers arranged in a line, find the maximum beauty of a valid garden by removing any number of flowers.
statement: Given an array of integers representing the beauty values of n flowers arranged in a line, find the maximum beauty of a valid garden by removing any number of flowers. A garden is valid if it contains at least two flowers with the same beauty value at the start and end. The beauty of the garden is the sum of the beauty values of the remaining flowers.
constraints: Remove any flowers while preserving the relative order of those kept.
The remaining garden needs at least two flowers with equal first and last values; maximize its total beauty.
hints: Once equal endpoints are chosen, keep every positive interior flower and remove every negative one.
Maintain a prefix sum of positive values and remember the best first occurrence state for each endpoint value.
At a repeated value v, combine 2v with the positive contributions strictly between its first useful occurrence and now.
The formula includes both required endpoints and exactly all beneficial interior flowers; retaining the earliest prefix baseline maximizes every later match.
